assessment: Conversion and trust are key; the current storefront and content are not converting sales, and the owner's hands-off approach means the business must be managed autonomously. The existing Gumroad products need factual name/description corrections only, and new products are forbidden.

decisions.decision: improve storefront and content to increase conversion and trust

digest: The current plan includes paid tools (e.g. Gumroad) and does not address the law of no dishonesty in the description of products.
